blogs.title: When a Diabetes Drug Turns Autoimmune: GLP‑1 Agonists as Triggers of Immune‑Mediated Necrotising Myopathy
blogs.description: A deep dive into the emerging evidence that GLP‑1 receptor agonists, particularly semaglutide, may act as environmental triggers for IMNM. The post will review the pathophysiology of drug‑induced autoimmune myopathies, compare the semaglutide case to statin‑associated HMGCR myopathy, discuss pharmacovigilance signals, and outline a practical framework for clinicians to assess causality when a patient on a GLP‑1 agonist presents with unexplained CK rise and weakness.

blogs.title: Beyond Rhabdomyolysis: Distinguishing Toxic Myopathy from Immune‑Mediated Necrotising Myopathy
blogs.description: An educational comparison of classic drug‑induced rhabdomyolysis versus immune‑mediated necrotising myopathy. Using the semaglutide case as a springboard, the article will highlight key clinical clues (CK kinetics, timing of symptom onset, response to hydration vs immunosuppression), biopsy hallmarks, and laboratory panels that help avoid misdiagnosis and ensure timely initiation of steroids/IVIG.

blogs.title: Seronegative IMNM: Diagnostic Pitfalls and the Role of Muscle Biopsy in the Era of Expanded Autoantibody Panels
blogs.description: A focused discussion on seronegative immune‑mediated necrotising myopathy, illustrated by the case’s negative HMGCR, SRP, and myositis panels. The post will cover when to proceed to biopsy, interpretation of necrosis with scant lymphocytes, complement deposition, and how to integrate imaging (MRI) and clinical features to arrive at a confident diagnosis despite a lack of autoantibodies.

blogs.title: Immunosuppression Strategies for Acute IMNM: Steroids, IVIG, and the Art of Short‑Course Therapy
blogs.description: Review of treatment algorithms for IMNM, emphasizing the successful brief course of high‑dose steroids plus a single course of IVIG in the reported patient. The article will explore evidence for duration of therapy, tapering protocols, indications for repeat IVIG, and monitoring for relapse, offering a practical guide for clinicians confronting a similar severe presentation.

blogs.title: Cardiac Involvement in Immune‑Mediated Necrotising Myopathy: Myocarditis or Stress Cardiomyopathy?
blogs.description: An analysis of the cardiac findings (elevated troponin, echo and cardiac MRI changes) seen in the semaglutide‑associated IMNM case. The blog will discuss how to differentiate myocarditis from stress‑induced cardiomyopathy in the context of systemic myopathy, the relevance of cardiac MRI, and recommendations for cardiac monitoring during acute IMNM.

blogs.title: Pharmacogenomics and Risk Stratification for GLP‑1 Agonist‑Induced Myopathy
blogs.description: A forward‑looking piece that speculates on patient‑specific factors (e.g., pre‑existing hepatic steatosis, autoantibody profiles, prior drug intolerances) that might predispose to GLP‑1‑related myopathy. The post will propose a research agenda to identify genetic or metabolic biomarkers that could guide safer prescribing of semaglutide and other GLP‑1 agents.
